neighbours.label: a different word right after a comma that restates the word just before it (a near-synonym: wishes, desires; big, huge)
fire: She whispered all her secret wishes, desires she had never told anyone.
The castle had a big, huge courtyard full of fountains.
He felt tired, exhausted after the long shift at the hospital.
It was a quiet, silent morning in the mountain village.
The puppy was small, tiny enough to fit in a teacup.
We need a quick, rapid response from the support team.
The old map was ancient, antique paper that crumbled at the edges.
Her answer was clear, obvious to everyone in the room.
quiet: She whispered all her secret wishes, then blew out the candles on the cake.
The castle had a big, sunny courtyard full of fountains.
He felt tired, but he still cooked dinner after the long shift.
It was a quiet, foggy morning in the mountain village.
The puppy was small, brown and fit easily in a teacup.
We need a quick response from the support team by Friday.
The old map was ancient, and someone had folded it into quarters.
